findings.current: Each stood well over a jang tall. Their corpses had already piled halfway up the wall.
findings.defect: The source describes the corpses as each well over a jang tall; the current wording instead says the giants stood that tall, shifting the detail from their bodies as they lie piled up to the giants themselves.
findings.rationale: The Korean makes “their corpses” the subject of the sentence and specifies each corpse’s height before describing the pile reaching halfway up the wall.
findings.replacement: Their corpses, each well over a jang tall, had already piled halfway up the wall.

summary: The assembled translation is faithful overall, with one minor physical-detail shift in the final description of the giants.
